info.name: Questions API — Bookmarks and student book
info.description:
# Frontend integration: bookmarks, student pages, My Bag

Base URL: `https://questions-api-navy.vercel.app`

All routes below are under `/api`.

## Auth

Login once, then send the token on every student request.

``` http
POST /api/login
Content-Type: application/json
{ "username": "st1", "password": "123456789" }

 ```

Response:

``` json
{
  "token": "jwt",
  "user": { "_id": "USER_ID", "username": "st1", "type": "student", "isActive": true }
}

 ```

Send either header:

``` http
Authorization: Bearer TOKEN

 ```

or `userId` on the query string / body. If both are sent, the token is used.

Without a user, list endpoints still work. Every `bookmarked` flag is `false`, and pages show the shared book only.

## Bookmarks

One call adds or removes a bookmark.

``` http
POST /api/bookmarks
Authorization: Bearer TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json

 ```

``` json
{
  "chapterId": "CHAPTER_ID",
  "type": "page",
  "itemId": "ITEM_ID"
}

 ```

`type` is one of:

`page` | `toc` | `glossary` | `recalls` | `illustrative-objects` | `exercises` | `question-objects` | `enriching-contents` | `micro-los`

| What the user tapped | Send |
| --- | --- |
| Page | `type: "page"`, `itemId`: page `_id` |
| TOC node | `type: "toc"`, itemId: node title |
| Glossary item | `type: "glossary"`, `itemId`: term |
| Recalls, illustrative objects, question objects, micro LOs | `itemId`: object `_id` |
| Exercise | `itemId`: `bookmarkId` (the exercise name) |
| Enriching content | `itemId`: `bookmarkId` (`contentValue`) |

TOC example. Bookmark **Why cells** from the Cell structure tree:

``` json
{
  "chapterId": "CHAPTER_ID",
  "type": "toc",
  "itemId": "Why cells"
}

 ```

Add `"language": "fr"` when the title comes from the French TOC.

Glossary example:

``` json
{
  "chapterId": "CHAPTER_ID",
  "type": "glossary",
  "title": "Nucleus"
}

 ```

The title is matched against `title` or `term`, including nested `children`.

If the same title exists twice, the API returns `409` and a `matches` array. Send the chosen `itemId` on the next call.

List a student's bookmarks: Use if bookmarks tab is required

``` http
GET /api/bookmarks?chapterId=CHAPTER_ID

 ```

Optional `type=toc` filters the list.

## Show the bookmark flag

Pass the same user on the existing reads. Each item includes `bookmarked`.

| Screen | Request |
| --- | --- |
| Pages | `GET /api/pages?chapterId=&language=` |
| TOC | `GET /api/chapters/:id/toc?lang=` |
| Glossary | `GET /api/chapters/:id/glossary` |
| Recalls | `GET /api/chapters/:id/recalls` |
| Illustrative objects | `GET /api/chapters/:id/illustrative-objects` |
| Exercises | `GET /api/chapters/:id/exercises` |
| Question objects | `GET /api/chapters/:id/question-objects` |
| Enriching contents | `GET /api/chapters/:id/enriching-contents` |
| Micro LOs | `GET /api/chapters/:id/micro-los` |

Render a filled icon when `bookmarked` is `true`.

## Student page edits

The shared book is not changed. Only this student sees the edits, and only when `GET /pages` is called with their user.

``` http
PUT /api/student-pages
Authorization: Bearer TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json

 ```

``` json
{
  "chapterId": "CHAPTER_ID",
  "pageId": "PAGE_ID",
  "blocks": [
    { "blockId": "BLOCK_ID", "contentValue": "The student's paragraph" }
  ],
  "v_blocks": [
    {
      "contents": [
        {
          "type": "text",
          "contentType": "Note",
          "contentValue": "Student note",
          "iconLocation": "L1"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

 ```

Rules:

- `blocks` replaces this student's paragraph edits for that page. Only paragraph blocks are applied on read. The next `GET /pages` returns that text and `studentEdited: true`.
    
- `v_blocks` replaces the virtual blocks this student added. They are appended after the shared blocks with `studentOwned: true`.
    
- Omit `blocks` or `v_blocks` to leave that part unchanged.
    
- `"blocks": []` clears paragraph edits. Pages return the original text and `studentEdited: false`.
    
- `"v_blocks": []` clears the student's virtual blocks. Pages return only the shared virtual blocks.
    

If you create a virtual block without `blockId`, the save response assigns one. Send that id again when updating the same note.

## Virtual blocks on GET /pages

Every virtual block has the same shape, whether or not the student added any:

``` json
{
  "blockId": "optional",
  "translations": [],
  "narration": [],
  "contents": [
    {
      "type": "object",
      "iconLocation": "TL",
      "contentType": "Recall",
      "contentValue": "OBJECT_ID"
    }
  ],
  "studentOwned": false
}

 ```

Use `contents` only. Ignore any other fields. `studentOwned: false` is a shared block. `studentOwned: true` is one this student added.

`contentValue` is an object id when `type` is `object`, a URL when `type` is `link`, and HTML when `type` is `text`.

## My Bag

My Bag is its own tab. It is not included in `GET /pages`.

Read it like the other tabs:

``` http
GET /api/chapters/CHAPTER_ID/my-bag

 ```

Response is an array of objects:

``` json
[
  {
    "_id": "OBJECT_ID",
    "name": "Question name",
    "url": "https://...",
    "type": "Text MCQ",
    "baseType": "Text MCQ",
    "saved": true
  }
]

 ```

Save the whole bag in one call. The array you send becomes the bag. Ids in the array are kept or added. Ids left out are removed.

``` http
POST /api/chapters/CHAPTER_ID/my-bag
Authorization: Bearer TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json
{ "ids": ["OBJECT_ID_1", "OBJECT_ID_2"] }

 ```

Each entry may be an id string or `{ "_id": "..." }`.

Clear the bag with `{ "ids": [] }`.

The response is the saved list, same shape as the GET.
